name: Prodiseum – Search, Color & Manage Icons
author: prodiseum

sections.description:
Prodiseum – Search, Color & Manage Icons brings a practical icon workflow directly into the WordPress dashboard. Search the bundled Tabler library or Iconify, recolor compatible icons, download SVG or PNG files, copy SVG code, and save ready-to-use PNG files directly to the Media Library.

Prodiseum is the publisher’s own brand, operated by Prodiseum Digital Dynamics. The official product site is https://prodiseum.com/.

2,982 Tabler outline icons are bundled with the plugin. They work immediately after activation with no API key, synchronization, or external download.

Free features:

  • 2,982 bundled Tabler outline SVG icons.
  • 14 local categories: CONTACT, ARROWS, DOCUMENTS & FOLDERS, ECOMMERCE, NATURE, NUMBERS, CHARTS, DATABASE, DEVICES, DESIGN, SHAPES, BUILDINGS & HOME, JOBS & CONSTRUCTION, and SPORTS.
  • Tabler is the default search provider.
  • Search Iconify with no API key.
  • Combined Tabler + Iconify search.
  • Popular search shortcuts by industry.
  • Recolor compatible monochrome icons with any HEX color.
  • Preserve original colors for multicolor icons.
  • Download SVG and PNG files.
  • Copy SVG code.
  • Save 512 × 512 transparent PNG icons to the WordPress Media Library.
  • Duplicate detection before saving.
  • My Library for viewing, renaming, filtering, and deleting icons saved by the plugin.

A separate commercial plugin, Iconarium Pro, is available from Prodiseum and adds additional icon sources and professional library-organization workflows. Premium functionality is not included, disabled, or license-gated inside this WordPress.org plugin.

External Services

The bundled Tabler library works locally and does not require an external service.

  • Iconify — optional online provider. No Iconify request is made by the default bundled Tabler provider. When the user explicitly selects Iconify or Tabler + Iconify and performs a search, the plugin sends the entered icon search term, an optional selected Iconify collection prefix, and requested icon identifiers to the official public API at api.iconify.design to retrieve icon metadata and SVG resources. The WordPress site URL is not sent in the plugin User-Agent. Service: https://iconify.design/ ; public API usage/documentation: https://iconify.design/docs/api/ ; privacy information: https://iconify.design/privacy/.

No remote icon provider is required for the default bundled Tabler search.

Source Code

All first-party PHP, JavaScript, and CSS source code required to run this plugin is included directly in the distributed plugin in human-readable form. No build step, package manager, transpiler, or minified first-party runtime bundle is required.

The bundled Tabler SVG icon source files are included under assets/tabler/. They come from the public Tabler Icons project (@tabler/icons 3.46.0): https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons . Tabler Icons are distributed under the MIT License; a copy is included in licenses/TABLER-ICONS-MIT.txt. The bundled catalog.json is a human-readable static metadata index used by the plugin and does not require a build step.
sections.installation:
1. Install Prodiseum – Search, Color & Manage Icons from WordPress.org or upload the plugin ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Prodiseum > Iconarium > Explore Icons.
  4. Search for an icon, select it, choose a color if desired, and download it or save it to the Media Library.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin require an API key?

No. The bundled Tabler library works locally and Iconify does not require an API key.

Can I recolor icons before downloading or saving them?

Yes. Compatible monochrome SVG icons can be recolored with any HEX value and previewed before SVG/PNG download or Media Library save.

Does Tabler need an internet connection?

No. The plugin includes 2,982 unique Tabler outline SVG files directly inside the plugin.

Where are saved icons stored?

PNG icons saved by the plugin are normal WordPress Media Library attachments. The My Library screen provides a focused view of those saved icons.

What does Iconarium Pro add?

Iconarium Pro is a separate plugin distributed outside WordPress.org. It adds additional sources and professional organization features such as custom collections, advanced categories and tags, bulk organization, and library import/export.
sections.changelog:
1.0.19

  • Final WordPress.org compliance audit: removed all remaining unused legacy collection/placeholder UI code, clarified bundled Tabler source and licensing, made external Iconify consent/data disclosure more explicit, hardened dynamic admin rendering, and shipped first-party CSS/JavaScript in clearly human-readable form.

1.0.18

  • Removed Freemius and all premium implementation from the WordPress.org Free codebase; premium capabilities are available only through the separate Iconarium Pro plugin.
  • Aligned the plugin folder, main file and text domain with the requested prodiseum-icon-manager slug.
  • Restricted automatic remote traffic to the official Iconify API, removed the site URL from the API User-Agent, tightened Media Library rename/delete authorization, documented source availability, and improved repository compliance.

1.0.16

  • Renamed the Free edition to Prodiseum – Search, Color & Manage Icons to match the Prodiseum Free-plugin naming standard.
  • Kept Iconarium as the product identity for the premium edition and internal icon workflow.

1.0.15

  • Added the required translator comments for dynamic admin labels.
  • Scoped the intentional Media Library meta-key query for Plugin Check while preserving the accurate saved-icon count.

1.0.14

  • Fixed saved-icon library count accuracy.

1.0.13

  • Simplified saved-icon organization: My Library is now the single saved-icons hub and Favorites has been removed from the visible Free workflow.
  • Replaced the separate Save to Media / Add to favorites actions with a single Add to My Library action.
  • Removed obsolete Favorites references from the Free vs Pro comparison and upgrade messaging.

1.0.12

  • Replaced the Prodiseum dashboard header logo with the light/white brand variant for improved contrast on the dark marble hero.

1.0.11

  • Increased the custom Prodiseum laurel icon so its visual weight matches standard WordPress admin menu icons.

1.0.10

  • Increased the Prodiseum laurel menu icon to match the visual size of standard WordPress admin icons.

1.0.9

  • Embedded the Prodiseum admin menu icon directly as SVG data to prevent stale browser caching and ensure the new laurel icon appears immediately after updating.

1.0.8

  • Adjusted the custom Prodiseum admin menu icon scale so it matches the visual size of standard WordPress sidebar icons more closely.

1.0.7

  • Refined the custom Prodiseum admin menu icon to a smaller, cleaner laurel mark for better alignment with the WordPress sidebar.

1.0.6

  • Replaced the default Prodiseum admin menu icon with a custom branded laurel-and-P SVG icon.

1.0.5

  • Fixed access to Iconarium Library, Licenses, Settings, and Free vs Pro screens from the third-level Prodiseum menu.
  • Reduced the Prodiseum logo size in the dashboard hero.
  • Replaced the dashboard Iconarium artwork with the official Iconarium product icon.

1.0.4

  • Refined the Prodiseum dashboard visuals with official plugin icons, a new marble hero header, tighter product cards, and improved installed-plugin card alignment.

1.0.3

  • Added a shared Prodiseum admin menu with Iconarium as a second-level product.
  • Added a third-level Iconarium flyout for Explore Icons, My Library, Licenses, Settings, and Free vs Pro.
  • Added a new Prodiseum dashboard with an installed-product overview and a restrained discovery area for other Prodiseum plugins.

1.0.2

  • Fixed Explore search and quick-search shortcuts in the Free edition.
  • Hardened the bundled Tabler thumbnail loader and provider selector.

1.0.1

  • Updated Iconarium product and upgrade links to https://prodiseum.com/iconarium.

1.0.0

  • Initial WordPress.org free edition.
  • Includes 2,982 bundled Tabler outline icons.
  • Tabler is the default search provider.
  • Includes Iconify and combined Tabler + Iconify search.
  • Includes icon recoloring, SVG/PNG download, SVG copy, and Media Library save.
  • Includes popular search shortcuts by industry.
  • Includes My Library for saved icons.
  • Adds a Free vs Pro comparison screen and a non-intrusive upgrade link above search results.
